QuestInfo.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Cleaning Tips 2
QuestInfo.0: Mrs. Ming Ming has 30 years in managing a household. She has agreed to teach you something about what she knows. Go see Mrs. Ming Ming.
QuestInfo.1: Mrs. Ming Ming believed that even useless Rubble from Golems could become the most helpful household tools depending on how they were used. She said she'd show Alpha and Beta how if they prepared the materials.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta learned from Mrs. Ming Ming how to use Golem rubble to make drinks cold and refreshing.

0.0: Okay, this time I'll teach you a more practical way to use Golem bits. We need more materials, too. Can you prepare everything?

yes.0: This time, we need #r#t4000965##k. Bring me #r#t4000965# x 10#k and I will blow your mind.

no.0: You need to thank me. Knowledge like this can't be bought with money.

1.0: Did you bring all the required materials?

yes.0: First, wash and clean the #r#t4000965##k in water. Then, if you put it into a drink like this... Oh look, the drink is nice an chilly now! Since the #r#t4000965##k doesn't melt, you can keep your beverages crisp and cool.

default.0: If you bring me #r#t4000965# x 10#k, I'll show you some magic.
